protocol.target: Provisional simultaneous 13-module aggregate hourly energy, kWh
protocol.target_formula: sum of activePower(kW)*5/3600 over 720 unique five-second samples per module, then sum over all 13 modules
protocol.meter_hierarchy_limitation: Unknown parent/child meter hierarchy can double count energy; not certified whole-facility consumption
protocol.time_key: Recorded localtime with exhaustive unique continuous five-second grid audit; supplied Unix timestamps have a March 9 offset transition inconsistent with Korean-time guide
protocol.horizon_convention: Origin offset h=0 is the first unobserved hour, equivalent to lead=1 relative to the last training observation. Conventional H96/H192/H336/H720 evaluate exactly H values at offsets 0..H-1; full task P745 evaluates offsets 0..744.
protocol.features: Observed target history and deterministically known calendar only; no future current, voltage, power factor, operation, power, or energy measurements
protocol.selection: Hyperparameters are selected only on blocked chronological validation. The internal test and May holdout are evaluated after frozen selection; no tuning uses those labels.
protocol.honest_holdout_disclosure: May labels were inspected during earlier descriptive EDA. This experiment is therefore a predeclared post-EDA lock, not a never-seen prospective holdout. No May-label-based hyperparameter tuning is allowed.
protocol.may_full_path: Apr30 00 h=0 through May31 00 h=744: 745 hourly predictions including the unlabelled bridge
protocol.may_scoring: Score only the supplied May10 00 through May31 00 labelled 505 rows, after selection and full-history refit
protocol.scale_note: May hourly_pow CSV lacks an explicit unit; comparison assumes its scale and aggregate scope match derived hourly kWh and reports that assumption
